subject: Home Management
examFormat: Three papers, all to be taken; Papers 1 and 2 form a composite paper taken at one sitting. Paper 1: fifty multiple choice objective questions in 1 hour for 50 marks. Paper 2: six essay questions, four to be answered within 1 hour 15 minutes for 50 marks. Paper 3: a 3-hour practical test conducted by a visiting examiner appointed by WAEC, carrying 100 marks.

subtopics.name: Definition of Home Management
objectives: Define home management

subtopics.name: Careers in Home Management
objectives: Identify careers in home management

subtopics.name: The Management Process
objectives: Describe the management process: planning, organization, implementation and evaluation
Apply the process to specific tasks

subtopics.name: Motivations for Home Management
objectives: Identify the motivations for home management: personal characteristics, values, goals, standards, needs and events

subtopics.name: Family Resources
objectives: Define family resources and state their characteristics
Identify the kinds of resources: human (time, energy, skill, work simplification as it applies to the home), non-human/material and community

subtopics.name: Decision-making
objectives: Define decision-making and describe the process

subtopics.name: The Family
objectives: Define the family
Identify types of family (nuclear, monogamous, polygamous, extended) and state the advantages and disadvantages of each
Describe the family life cycle: beginning, expanding, contracting and empty-nest
State the functions of the family
Describe the roles and responsibilities of family members (e.g. mother, father, children, working mothers, single parent)

Describe family relationships (husband and wife, parent/child, sibling/sibling, nuclear and extended families), the factors affecting them (e.g. communication, family values), their effect on well-being, and conflict and conflict resolution

subtopics.name: Courtship and Marriage
objectives: Identify types of marriage
Define boy/girl relationship (traditional/custom) and state guidelines for a healthy relationship
Describe the problems of unhealthy boy/girl relationships and the consequences of indiscriminate sexual indulgence
Explain sex education
State the factors to consider when choosing a life partner (e.g. blood group, genotype, HIV status)
Describe dating, courtship and engagement
Describe preparation for marriage: readiness (where to live, maturity, finances) and introduction to each other's family
Describe the marriage ceremony in different localities

subtopics.name: Parenthood
objectives: Describe preparation for parenthood: planning a family, reproduction, pregnancy and ante-natal care
Describe child birth: labour, delivery and post-natal care (immunization)
Explain the meaning, importance and responsibilities of parenting (provision of needs, bathing etc.)

topics.name: Feeding the Family
objectives: Describe the classes of food and food nutrients
Describe the scientific study of good nutrients
State the effect of heat on nutrients
Describe the special nutrition needs of infants, toddlers, adolescents, adults, pregnant women, lactating women, the aged, convalescents, invalids and vegetarians
Describe food storage and preservation
Plan balanced meals for different groups of people
Describe kitchen plan, hygiene and safety
Describe food purchasing
Prepare and serve meals, snacks and beverages: cooking terms and methods, flour and flour mixtures, cooking equipment, utensils and table wares, table setting and service
Describe entertainment

subtopics.name: Clothing
objectives: State the meaning, types and functions of clothing

subtopics.name: Textiles
objectives: Describe the origin of fibres
Classify fibres and fabrics

subtopics.name: Fabric Construction
objectives: Describe fabric construction by weaving, knitting, crocheting etc.

subtopics.name: Maintenance of Clothing
objectives: Carry out simple garment repairs
Identify laundry agents: water, detergents, fabric rinses, stiffening agents, bleaches
Identify laundry equipment and tools
Carry out laundry work: management of the family wash, stains and stain removal, care of special garments

subtopics.name: Family House
objectives: Define a house
Identify types of house (e.g. storey building, bungalow, duplex)
Classify houses, e.g. traditional and modern

subtopics.name: Choosing Family House
objectives: Describe ways of acquiring a house: renting, mortgage, building, buying, inheritance, gift
Describe the factors influencing the choice of a house: economic, social, psychological, sites, ventilation, design
State guidelines for choosing a family house

subtopics.name: Setting up a Home
objectives: Define a home and state the difference between a home and a house
Identify equipment and furnishing in the home: large and small equipment, hard and soft furnishing, fixtures

subtopics.name: Home Improvement/Interior Decoration
objectives: State the meaning and importance of home improvement/interior decoration
Apply the elements and principles of art and design (colours, textures, lines, proportion, rhythm etc.)
State guidelines for interior decoration
Carry out flower arrangements

subtopics.name: Utilities in the Home
objectives: Describe water: sources, uses, purification and storage
Describe light: electricity, meter reading and electric bill
Describe fuels (cooking gas, kerosene, firewood, charcoal, electricity): uses, storage, control, advantages and disadvantages

subtopics.name: Simple Home Maintenance and Repairs
objectives: Identify, prepare and use local and commercial cleaning agents and materials (water, soaps, abrasives, polishes)
Identify cleaning equipment and tools
Care for surfaces: wood, tile, formica, concrete, plastic etc.
Care for floors/floor coverings/finishing: carpets, linoleums, mats, rugs, terrazzo, parquet etc.
Care for home furnishing and ornaments: ceramics, metals, collage etc.
Clean different functional areas in the home
Make a bed

subtopics.name: Safety Measures in the Home
objectives: State the importance of safety measures
Identify common accidents and their prevention
Use first aid

subtopics.name: Sanitation in the Home
objectives: Define sanitation and state its importance
Describe waste disposal: household waste, drainage system, disposal methods, pollution and health hazards
Identify household pests (types) and their control

subtopics.name: Creativity and Entrepreneurship
objectives: State the meaning and importance of creativity and entrepreneurship
Explain the relationship between creativity and entrepreneurship
Identify entrepreneurial skills: creativity, management, communication
Identify entrepreneurial activities/enterprises: fashion designing, hair dressing, fast foods, bead making etc.

subtopics.name: Money Management
objectives: State the meaning, guidelines and processes of money management
Prepare a family budget: income, expenditure, steps in budgeting

subtopics.name: Wealth Creation
objectives: State the meaning, types and advantages of wealth
Describe ways of creating wealth, e.g. saving, investment, trading

subtopics.name: Capital Market Investment
objectives: State the meaning, advantages and guidelines of capital market investment
Identify investment opportunities, e.g. stocks, shares, treasury bills

subtopics.name: Definition and Importance of Consumer Education
objectives: Define consumer education and state its importance

subtopics.name: Rights and Responsibilities of a Consumer
Consumer Information
objectives: Identify the sources and uses of consumer information

subtopics.name: Consumer Legislation and Agencies
objectives: Identify the types and functions of consumer agencies
State the regulations of agencies

subtopics.name: Consumer Agents
objectives: Identify the types and functions of consumer agents

subtopics.name: Purchasing Practices
objectives: Define market and market survey, state types, uses/importance and procedures for market survey
Describe wise purchasing practices
Describe prevention of wastage in the home
